sequencing_rules: AFFiNE installation/synchronization is never a prerequisite for a research task; task-level research readiness is authoritative.
Complete all available P0 free work autonomously.
Enter paid P1 tasks only when exact prerequisites, access, cost feasibility and authority hold.
Eligible free P2/P4/P5 tasks may proceed by named dependencies while a paid or AFFiNE lane is blocked.
P4 is an integrated workstream, not a waterfall delay until every research experiment ends.
P5 writing starts early; positive-method submission readiness requires supported P2 evidence and the contribution claims actually made.
No phase or task is COMPLETE merely because a document was drafted, an owner deadline approaches or a board checkbox changed.
No automatic maintenance-only pivot after an acquisition failure.
